title: Seed permissions and immutable system roles
summary: Implemented the governed 57-permission catalog and eight immutable system-role templates with explicit risk/scope metadata, strict YAML semantics, PostgreSQL ownership constraints, idempotent advisory-locked synchronization, rename/removal protection, immutable checksum revisions, db:seed integration and a development matrix report that is tested against the blueprint documentation.

migrations: 20260904075000 creates four empty authorization catalog tables with UUID keys
decisions: permission scope metadata is organization-only or project-safe; stable keys cannot disappear during sync; system role metadata and grants are ordinary-application read-only while the advisory-locked catalog sync is the sole controlled reconciliation path; authorization remains permission-based and never role-name-based
risks: A privileged direct database operator can bypass model immutability; revision checksums and deployment review are the detection/governance boundary. A reviewed future YAML revision may deliberately remove a system-role grant
so grant reductions require explicit security review. Role assignments and effective permission decisions are intentionally deferred to subsequent prompts.
next_steps: Prompt 030 implements tenant-safe role assignments and converts accepted invitation role intent into effective grants
